procedures.label: Place the apple in the sack

steps.description: Locate the selected apple and the designated checkout sack.
Approach the apple from an unobstructed direction.
Acquire a stable hold on the apple.
Lift the apple clear of the checkout surface.
Move the apple into the designated sack.
Verify the apple is inside the sack.

success_criteria: The selected apple is inside the designated checkout sack.
setup: Provide the cited generic apple model and a sack on the checkout counter; verify the actual assets and handling method before collection.
reset: Return the apple and sack to their marked checkout-counter positions and inspect both for damage.
quality_checks: Confirm the apple is contained by the sack and no drop or visible damage occurred.

procedures.label: Move the banana from its breakfast plate into the refrigerator

steps.description: Locate the banana, its plate, and the refrigerator destination.
Approach the banana without disturbing nearby breakfast items.
Acquire a stable hold on the banana model.
Lift the banana clear of its plate.
Move to the refrigerator access area.
Open the refrigerator if required by the selected scene setup.
Place the banana inside the refrigerator.
Verify the banana is inside the refrigerator.

success_criteria: The banana is inside the refrigerator.
setup: Place the cited generic banana model on a plate on the breakfast table and make the refrigerator destination accessible; leave other table-clearing goals out of this primitive.
reset: Return the banana to its marked plate position on the breakfast table and restore the refrigerator to the recorded initial state.
quality_checks: Confirm the banana is inside the refrigerator and that nearby breakfast items remain undisturbed.

draft_notes: Atlas graph traversal requested for the sibling proposal: task_reference_behavior_apple_bag_at_checkout --acts_on--> behavior_object_apple_agveuv --instance_of--> concept:object_fruit. This is exactly two upward Atlas relation edges. task_reference_behavior_banana_clear_breakfast acts_on behavior_object_banana_vvyyyv, which is attached to the same Atlas ObjectClass grouping object_fruit.

BEHAVIOR source taxonomy is recorded independently: apple-agveuv belongs to category apple mapped to apple.n.01, whose parents include edible_fruit.n.01 and pome.n.01; banana-vvyyyv belongs to category banana mapped to banana.n.02, whose parent is edible_fruit.n.01. The Atlas concept object_fruit is not asserted equivalent to any BEHAVIOR synset.

Resource IDs beginning behavior_resource_ are explicit external scene/object requirements from the source task definitions. They are not cataloged YCB items or claims that matching physical assets are available.

This isolated draft requires the generic external-object support currently being added. The existing ObjectInstance schema requires a YCB ID, so external_objects must remain a separate draft collection until that API/schema support is available.
